summary: PR #59 bumps rubygems/release-gem from 1.4.1 to 1.4.2 in publish.yml (SHA-pinned), a workflow-only dependency change with no application code impact. The two reported failing checks, test (macos-latest, 3.4) and test (macos-latest, 3.2), both report conclusion 'cancelled', not 'failure'. This branch received three sequential pushes to the same ref (5e8d1e3, 58478f6, 8f380ce), and ci.yml's `concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true }` cancels any in-progress run on that ref when a new commit is pushed. That setting fully explains a 'cancelled' (not 'failed') conclusion on an earlier push's run without requiring any workflow or code fix. A prior run on this same branch (commit 8f380ce) additionally inspected the GitHub Actions job pages directly and found the macOS jobs had zero executed steps with a 'not acquired by Runner of type hosted' annotation, consistent with either runner-capacity or cancel-in-progress behavior rather than a test/build failure. I corrected the one real defect found in that prior run: it had committed the run-local tmp/paid-agent-verification.json file into the PR (commit 8f380ce), which I removed in a follow-up commit (a9923fa) so the artifact stays untracked. All locally runnable checks (lint, standardrb, full rspec suite) pass clean at the new HEAD.

verification.rationale: Whether the macos-latest 3.4/3.2 'cancelled' jobs will complete successfully on the next CI run cannot be settled from this Linux container: macOS-hosted runner availability and the effect of this branch's concurrency cancel-in-progress setting on a prior in-progress run are GitHub-side states this environment has no API/network access to inspect or re-trigger.
limitations: No gh CLI or GitHub API access is available in this environment to pull live job logs/annotations for the current HEAD's run.
Cannot distinguish with certainty between concurrency-group cancellation (expected, benign) and transient macOS runner capacity shortage (external, also benign) without GitHub Actions run data.
macOS-specific native extension build behavior (numo-narray/rover-df) cannot be reproduced in this Linux container.

references.result: explains 'cancelled' (not 'failed') conclusion on a run superseded by a later push to the same ref

verification.rationale: Ran the full locally-runnable lint and test suites at the new HEAD after removing the mistakenly-tracked verification artifact, to confirm no regression was introduced and the branch's actually-fixable issues (numo-narray/GCC exclusion, lint cleanliness) remain resolved.
limitations: Only Linux-side checks were run; macOS runner behavior is out of scope for local verification (see AC-1).
